objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use the signing oracle to forge a signature on the second message and read the flag.
hints: The server scales its private key by a value you choose before it signs.
Write the signature equation and see how the scaled key relates to the original one.

steps.title: Identify the signature scheme
steps.prompt: Which signature algorithm does the server use?

steps.title: Find your input
steps.prompt: What do you control in the first signature request? (what is multiplied)

steps.title: Name the attack class
steps.prompt: What class of attack abuses signatures made under a key related to the target key?
